findings.summary: The lib-06/lib-07/lib-08 cases share the three_bus_radial fixture with the lib-01..lib-05 training side; their distinction is REGIME (PV ramp, asset dropout, reverse power flow), not topology. Held out literally as 'topology families' they would be near-duplicates of training topologies (the P8.12 named risk). Resolution: lib-06/07/08 scenario material is assigned to the HELD-OUT OPERATING-REGIME track (fam-regime-holdout-lib-06-07-08), and the topology hold-out is the generator-produced families declared below, structurally disjoint by construction.

The P8.10 RECOMMENDED training set (families of lib-01..lib-05) includes the MESHED meshed_two_feeder fixture (lib-03), while the P8.10 D3 obligation declares balanced radial feeders as the 0.x scope RECOMMENDATION with meshed OUT unless explicitly scoped. Resolution: the meshed family is EXCLUDED from GNN training topology instances by default; inclusion requires a new explicitly scoped decision (a RadialAndMeshed analogue of the P4.34 adapter scope) BEFORE training. D3 remains OPEN.
